slice 2 pigment::track_math (a73b1ed..3acced1): LumaFrame (checked; from_plane = BT.709 luma of premultiplied colour), track_points = pyramidal Lucas-Kanade (Bouguet 2000; [1 3 3 1]/8 pyramid, level count from feature/search radius with half a window per level, frame to frame, forward or backward from any start frame = manual-correction path) + Shi-Tomasi 1994 six-parameter affine refinement at level 0; per-point feature radius and search region; NCC confidence; statuses Tracked / LowConfidence / Lost (search region exceeded) / OutOfFrame (feature region leaves the frame) / Degenerate (per-sample min eigenvalue below min_eigen or flat window); CancellationToken + determinate progress (STU-CMP-065a); solve_one_point (offset), solve_two_point (offset, unwrapped clockwise rotation, scale), solve_corner_pin + Homography::fit (Hartley-normalised DLT, least squares for more than 4 points, partial-pivot elimination, typed Degenerate); TrackLimits refuse search/feature radius, frame pixels, pyramid bytes and work before allocation; module denies clippy::arithmetic_side_effects

slice 3 composite::track_apply (bf3aac0): MotionTrack (from one-point samples or a two-point solve, analysed frames only), TrackTiming (frame -> composition tick, checked), apply_track (chosen properties only: position = attach + offset, rotation = base + track, scale = base * track; linear Folio StudioCompositionKeyframes; an existing stream is replaced with its static value kept; input record untouched = reversible history swap), stabilize (anchor follows the feature; position/rotation/scale invert the motion toward the lock-off reference or a centred moving average of radius smoothing_frames; per-axis choice); typed refusals; module denies clippy::arithmetic_side_effects

slice 4 pigment::track_math::track_planar (960af0a..901092e): PlanarSpec (convex quad, max features, feature/search radius, min spacing, RANSAC iterations, inlier threshold, seed); Shi-Tomasi features (per-sample min eigenvalue, greedy non-maximum suppression, deterministic tie order) inside the quad; frame-to-frame KLT matches (only confident Tracked matches vote); per frame seeded SplitMix64 RANSAC (Fischler-Bolles) of exact 4-point homographies, least-squares refit re-scored until the inlier set is stable, outliers retired; PlanarFrame {homography from the start frame, mapped quad = animated 4-vertex mask path, features, inliers, Tracked/Lost (last homography held)}; Degenerate when fewer than 4 features; cancellation, progress, budget refusals before allocation

spec_basis.STU-CMP-032: Keying is the extraction of an alpha channel from image content, and Studio ships a keying family, not a key. (capability table: chroma key, colour key, colour-difference key, colour range key, luma key, linear colour key, difference matte, extract, inner/outer key, key cleaner, spill suppressor, matte choker, simple choker, wire removal, unmult)
spec_basis.STU-CMP-032a: Every one of these is a StudioLiveFilter in the keying or matte category of [STU-FX-126], carries the full parameter contract of 14.9.1 ... Only 3 of the 21 recovered keying and matte entries have typed parameter records, so the remainder fall under declared gap [STU-FX-146] and their parameter authoring is explicit scope.
spec_basis.STU-CMP-033: A key is a MATTE PIPELINE, not a single effect ... pre-process (denoise, degrain, blur the screen only), extract (one or more keys, combined), refine (choke, spread, feather, edge-blur, hole-fill), despill, and re-integrate ... Studio MUST NOT ship a single opaque key operation that hides these stages.
spec_basis.STU-CMP-034: DECLARED GAP -- rotoscoping ... until it is specified an implementer builds the manual path and does not improvise a propagation algorithm. (not built here)
spec_basis.STU-CMP-065: Tracking produces animation data ... a track's output is ordinary keyframes on ordinary properties ([STU-MOT-030]) ... One point solves position; two solve position, rotation and scale; four solve a corner-pin. ... Apply to target: applying a track writes keyframes onto a chosen target's chosen properties ... a normal reversible history step ... Stabilization: the same analysis applied inversely to hold a feature still, with an explicit choice of which axes to stabilize and a smoothing amount ... Planar / mask tracking ... producing an animated mask path.
spec_basis.STU-CMP-065a: Tracking is a long-running, cancellable, observable analysis subject to the headless and quiet law ([STU-FX-038]): it never opens a foreground window, reports determinate progress, and is fully drivable by typed command.
spec_basis.STU-CMP-065b: DECLARED GAP. No tracker parameter records were recovered. Feature-region and search-region sizing, the confidence metric and its threshold, the smoothing model and the solve's error metric all require deliberate authoring under 14.9.1.
